checks.name: Property changes never reuse the previous property thumbnail
Close inspector is one atomic history entry and Back returns to the valid selected floor
Register history restores both the route and its actual selected unit
View in map executes the new focus command at the selected floor elevation
Floor-local notes, measurements, unit association and revisions survive revisits and reload
Crossed measurement cannot enter review; Control-Q clears only the drawing and retains notes
Check source reads and validates the original bytes, reports failures and succeeds only after recovery
Export is a nonempty actual rendered PNG and modal keyboard focus stays contained
Browser-emulated held touch pan and cancellation recover on the real canvas
Failed 3D resource exposes a recoverable error without inventing a map or changing property identity
